text: 10月16日，上交所副总经理苑多然在全球财富管理论坛·2026上海苏河湾大会上表示，近年来，上交所持续深化互联互通机制，丰富跨境投资产品，坚定不移推进资本市场对外开放。
text_en: On October 16, Yuan Duoran, Vice President of the Shanghai Stock Exchange, said at the Global Wealth Management Forum·2026 Shanghai Suhewan Conference that in recent years the Shanghai Stock Exchange has continued to deepen the interconnection mechanism, enrich cross-border investment products, and unswervingly promote the opening up of the capital market.
